dialogues.speaker: Opera Epiclese Notice Board
dialogues.text: Rules of the Opera Epiclese and Announcements Pertaining to the Opera Epiclese. Not for other usage.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "The damage previously caused in an accident during the staging of 'The Final Battle of the White Armada' has been repaired."

dialogues.speaker: Administrative Announcement
dialogues.text: "In the coming days, Mr. Bletchley of the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering will display a modified combat clockwork meka — an improved version of the Lord-Artificer's Cal. Scherbius.

dialogues.speaker: Administrative Announcement
dialogues.text: "...Due to the peculiarity of this exhibit, the Maison Gardiennage reserves the right to implement preventative questionings and controls. For details, refer to AOCF-008.EA-T-099."

dialogues.speaker: Administrative Announcement
dialogues.text: "...Non-Maison Gestion approved activities at the Salacia Plain, Thalatta Submarine Canyon, and all underwater regions within 1 kilometer of the Fortress of Meropide (including non-underwater areas beneath sea level)..."

dialogues.speaker: Administrative Announcement
dialogues.text: "...These will be deemed illegal activities during the construction of a tunnel at the Opera Epiclese... For details, refer to AOCF-036.T-108C."

dialogues.speaker: Administrative Announcement
dialogues.text: (Scribbled graffiti: "None will stop me from finding the Ordo's secret treasure!")

dialogues.speaker: Performance Announcement
dialogues.text: "The fantastical masterpiece of the great Coppelius, 'Clockwork Coppelia'!"

dialogues.speaker: Performance Announcement
dialogues.text: "...Spiritual sequel 'Pygmalion in the Mirror' will soon take to the stage!"

dialogues.speaker: Performance Announcement
dialogues.text: "The greatest tale of heroism from the pre-Cataclysm era — of the gallant defense of Poisson, a relentless pursuit of tyrants and bandits! The most exciting historical opera in recent decades will soon be performed at the opera house!"

dialogues.speaker: Performance Announcement
dialogues.text: "The script has passed through Maison Gestion and Gardiennage supervision to recreate the real-life events."
